messages:
taylor: Quick postmortem action thread Summary: control-plane cert rollover at our cloud provider triggered intermittent TLS handshake failures to model-registry endpoints -> auth failures -> request queue growth -> elevated tail latency for hosted inference. Not a code bug, but we amplified the problem.

devin: Do we have the provider rotation window and whether they warned customers?

renee: Provider says rotation window 04/02 14:05-14:07 UTC, but our telemetry shows TLS handshake errors spiked 14:05:20 -> 14:06:50. They published a notice at 14:04 but our watch didn't catch it. Link: https://cloud.example.com/announce/2026-04-02-cert-rot

omar: From infra traces, many clients reconnected aggressively and refreshed caches, which caused thundering reconnects against the registry and auth service. Our client library attempted 5 immediate reconnects with no backoff. Needs fixing.

nina: Proposed actions: 1) Implement jittered exponential reconnect/backoff in model-registry client (owner: @omar, ETA: 2026-04-07) 2) Add TLS-handshake alert (x509 handshake error rate > 0.2% over 2m) and correlate with 5xx spike (owner: @devin, ETA: 2026-04-05) 3) Add a provider-notice detector (subscribe to their RSS/announce feed + webhook) and auto-create an incident channel (owner: @taylor, ETA: 2026-04-03) 4) Add a CI litmus test that simulates cert rollovers and validates client backoff + cached cert fallback (owner: @renee, ETA: 2026-04-14) 5) Request formal rotation SLA and staged rollout option from provider (owner: @nina, ETA: 2026-04-17).

ops-bot: Maintenance: created calendar item for runbook edits on 2026-04-05 10:00 UTC by taylor.

taylor: I agree with the list. One more: add a temporary circuit-breaker that rejects new non-critical inference requests when registry TLS error rate > threshold to protect control plane. (owner: @taylor, ETA: 2026-04-06)

omar: For client change: I'll push a small helper lib that centralizes reconnection policy. Prototype branch: https://git.redwood/infra/branches/reconnect-policy-proto. Will include unit tests for jitter/backoff.

devin: I'll author the Prom rule and small Grafana panel. Alert to page SRE and create channel slack/incidents/1891000000-cert-rollover. Suggested threshold: handshake_error_rate > 0.2% AND concurrent open conns > 2x baseline for 2m.

renee: Runbook items to add: detection steps, isolating impacted regions, temporary routing to standby registry cluster, and provider contact script. I'll draft runbook PR: https://git.redwood/infradocs/runbooks/pulls/160 by Monday.

nina: Related pattern: we had a similar outage cause in 2025-09 where provider cert rotation combined with client reconnect loops caused latencies. This is becoming a recurring dependency class. We should propose a vendor tabletop quarterly and require notification lead time in our enterprise agreement. I'll coordinate with partnerships.

sre-bot: Correlation query: matching incidents found (2025-09-21-cert, 2026-01-09-network-blip). Recommend scheduling provider tabletop and adding dependency risk item to quarterly roadmap.

taylor: Also add an automated test in our canary pipeline that tears down TLS trust for a short window to validate fallback behavior. That prevents regressions. (owner: taylor, ETA: 2026-04-14)

omar: One small mitigation we can ship fast: client-side cache of last-valid server cert (with TTL and KMS-protected sig) to allow a short grace period if the provider rotates without warning. I'll prototype but will need security review. (owner: omar, ETA: 2026-04-10)

devin: I'll wire the alert to link directly to the runbook + rollout playbook when available. Also propose a policy: if provider rotation is detected, increase circuit-breaker sensitivity and reduce retry budgets for non-critical paths automatically via feature flag. (owner: devin, ETA: 2026-04-08)

renee: Posting initial runbook draft here once PR is open. Also will include a pre-rotation checklist for staged validation (call registry endpoints, verify TLS chains, smoke inference).

nina: Owners recap: taylor=provider notice detector + circuit-breaker gate + canary test, devin=alerts + dashboard + policy flag, omar=reconnect lib + cert-cache prototype, renee=runbook + CI test, nina=vendor SLA/tabletop. Please add missing owners or conflicts.

taylor: FYI I'll coordinate with security on cert-cache approach. We can't bypass proper trust checks; cache only for short emergency windows and audit all uses.

ops-bot: Reminder: oncall rotation starting 2026-04-06.

sre-bot: Archived incident link will be attached to postmortem when all owners mark actions done.

devin: I'll drop a PR for the alerting rules today, pinging SRE for review.

omar: I'll open the reconnect lib PR and include integration tests that simulate provider-side cert change. Branch: https://github.com/redwood/serving/branches/reconnect-shield.

renee: Will land runbook PR by EOD Monday and will ping for quick reviews.

nina: Please drop short progress updates here by next Thursday so we can close actions. :white_check_mark:
__notes: Synthetic Slack thread for postmortem follow-ups about a cloud provider cert rollover that caused TLS/auth issues. Designed per agents.md: single-thread string, short messages, owners and ETAs listed. All fields are strings or list of strings.
